answer: A trading agent cooperative shipping pearl jewelry and saffron across the ocean protects its treasury with a 3-of-5 multisignature rule. Five independently controlled custodian keys are fixed in the spending contract; each withdrawal needs three distinct signatures over its amount, recipient and unused nonce. Newly registered agents get no signing authority, so a swarm cannot drain funds by manufacturing a voting majority. This depends on fewer than three custodians colluding and secure key custody.
